lines.text: Joshua tells the Reubenites, Gadites and half-tribe of Manasseh to go home, keep the law, and blesses them.
The three tribes build an imposing altar at Geliloth near the Jordan, and Israel gathers at Shiloh to go to war.
Israel sends Phinehas son of Eleazar with ten chiefs, who say the altar is a breach of faith like the sin of Sinai.
The three tribes say they built the altar as a witness, and that their descendants should look at a replica of the LORD's altar.
Phinehas and the chiefs are satisfied, Israel blesses God and drops the war plans, and the tribes name the altar Memorial.
